content.short: KALOS focuses on making Web3 space safe for everyone.
content.description: KALOS began in 2018 as the smart contract audit service of HAECHI. Since then, KALOS has secured more than $60B in crypto assets across 500+ global projects — including L1/L2, DeFi, P2E, and bridges — with notable work for 1inch, Sushiswap, BadgerDAO, SuperRare, and Chainsafe. The team comprises world-class security researchers who enjoy hacking competitions, bug bounties, and security audits. Highly ranked in Paradigm CTF with trophies from HITCON and SECCON, they review Web2, Web3, and cryptography to secure digital assets.
